name: Tom Jobbins
fame_basis: Hugging Face account with about 27,500 followers and more than 3,800 models, the main early source of quantized (GPTQ, AWQ, GGUF) community model releases.
bio: TheBloke is a Hugging Face account, shown on its profile as Tom Jobbins, that published quantized versions of open language models in GPTQ, AWQ and GGML/GGUF formats, making many models usable on consumer hardware. The account has been inactive for new model uploads since January 2024; its last upload was CapybaraHermes-2.5-Mistral-7B.
known_for: Quantized GPTQ, AWQ and GGUF releases of open LLMs
Making local LLM use practical on consumer hardware
